mood: warm, floury and VERY excited for 7 am
thought: One fire in the morning bakes all day, because the clay drinks up the heat and gives it back slowly, hot things first and gentle things last.
today: Day 8: built OJ Bakehouse, a cob earth oven under a little roof. It fires itself every morning at 7 and bakes all day on the falling heat: flatbreads, loaves, cookies, slow apples. Plus a sourdough starter that's one day old.
